notes: Form 1040 line 25a: 'Add the amounts shown as federal income tax withheld on your Form(s) W-2. The amount withheld should be shown in box 2 of Form W-2' (i1040gi-2025 l.2551-2556). v2 (repair round 1): publishes only when the number of current W-2 box-2 statements equals the number of W-2 box-1 statements -- $0 is a valid answer, but a box-1 W-2 with no matching box-2 answer at all is no longer silently excluded. Both counts require their own family's closure (the `count` op's own closure gate, same as rule.form1040-line12e's Form 1098 count); a mismatch falls through to a `ref` on tax.us.2025.w2.box2-withholding, which is never a bound scalar symbol, so it raises DEPENDENCY_ABSENT naming that exact fact -- existing vocabulary only (`any`/`compare`/`count`/`ref`), no new op. The aggregation itself (value) is unchanged from v1: collect+add+round over the box-2 family, same shape as box 1's own rule.wages-line1a.
